_comment: Multi-period roots: funded evolution/forecast/compare read >=2 DATED platform cuts under the platform root; weekly pipeline funnel/conversion reads the dated snapshots under the pipeline root. Omit either only if that book is not published.
name: MI_AGENT_ONBOARDING_OUTPUT_ROOT

_comment: React dashboard authentication. 'swa' (default) accepts ONLY the Static Web Apps X-MS-CLIENT-PRINCIPAL header — the pre-migration shape, so deploying the bearer code with this value changes nothing. 'both' additionally accepts an Entra access token, which is the cutover mode: the MSAL path can be proven while the existing admin login keeps working. 'bearer' stops honouring the header, which is what finally closes the direct-to-API side door. See docs/react_multitenant_auth_migration.md.
name: TRAKT_MI_REACT_AUTH_MODE

_comment: Audience(s) the dashboard token must name, comma-separated — the Application ID URI of the trakt-mi-api Entra App Registration (optionally also its bare app id GUID). Required once the mode is 'both' or 'bearer'; without it every token is answered 503, not 401.
name: TRAKT_MI_ENTRA_AUDIENCE

_comment: Delegated scope the dashboard token must carry. Defaults to MI.Access when unset; set to an empty string only as a deliberate decision to accept any token naming the audience above. A Copilot scope or an agent app role must never admit a caller here.
name: TRAKT_MI_REQUIRED_SCOPE

_comment: Named-user licensing, fail closed. Off (default) keeps the Stage 1 posture: a directory with nobody registered in config/principals.yaml is not principal-gated. Turn ON only once every dashboard user has been registered — doing it sooner refuses everyone, including the operator performing the migration.
name: TRAKT_MI_REACT_REQUIRE_PRINCIPAL

_comment: Microsoft 365 Copilot v1 actions (/v1/copilot/*). Default mode is 'entra' and FAILS CLOSED (503) until tenant + audience are set. See docs/copilot_v1_implementation.md.
name: TRAKT_COPILOT_AUTH_MODE

_comment: One Entra directory GUID, or a comma-separated list of them. A single value is the current single-client shape and needs no change. Directories registered in config/organisations.yaml are accepted in addition to whatever is listed here, so a second organisation does not require editing this setting. NOTE: despite the Copilot-era name, this is the allow-list for EVERY token-authenticated surface — Copilot, the agent tool API and (once TRAKT_MI_REACT_AUTH_MODE is 'both'/'bearer') the React dashboard. One allow-list, deliberately: registering an organisation opens exactly one door.
name: TRAKT_COPILOT_ENTRA_TENANT_ID

_comment: Entra directory GUIDs the DASHBOARD accepts tokens from, comma-separated. REQUIRED for 'both'/'bearer' unless config/organisations.yaml lists them: with no directory on the allow-list every bearer request answers 503, whatever the audience says.
name: TRAKT_MI_ENTRA_TENANT_ID
